dedupe_keys.name: green infrastructure elements in the urban and commuting zones in 2018 eea version 1

description: This European Environment Agency dataset maps green infrastructure elements in the functional urban areas, meaning the cities and their commuting zones, of 786 cities in the EEA38 countries and the United Kingdom for 2018. It classifies green urban areas, private gardens, sports and leisure areas, allotments, trees, natural and semi-natural areas, high nature value farmland, and blue elements such as wetlands and water. The EEA produced it from Copernicus and OpenStreetMap inputs to support planning of green and blue networks for ecosystem services, health and climate adaptation. Coverage is European urban and commuting zones for the reference year 2018 on a 10 m grid in the European LAEA projection. Format and access: GeoTIFF by direct download from the EEA geospatial catalogue, version 1 published on 30 September 2021. Licence: CC BY 4.0 from the EEA, with the Copernicus data policy and the ODbL for OpenStreetMap-derived parts; free. Caveats: a single year, class accuracy depends on the inputs, and private gardens are modelled. It supports climate adaptation, urban heat and stormwater studies that treat green space as infrastructure. A related catalogue record is the Natural England Green Infrastructure Mapping Database, a national counterpart for England.
